subtitle.en: AI-Powered Food Waste Reduction & Healthy Living Assistant
subtitle.id: Asisten Pengurangan Limbah Makanan & Hidup Sehat berbasis AI

overview.en: Remilque is a mobile application designed to tackle the paradox of food waste and malnutrition in Indonesia. With 41% of national waste being food and 1 in 5 children suffering from stunting, Remilque bridges the gap by transforming leftover ingredients into healthy, economical, and quick recipes using AI technology.
overview.id: Remilque adalah aplikasi seluler yang dirancang untuk mengatasi paradoks limbah makanan dan malnutrisi di Indonesia. Dengan 41% sampah nasional berupa makanan dan 1 dari 5 anak mengalami stunting, Remilque menjembatani kesenjangan dengan mengubah sisa bahan menjadi resep sehat, hemat, dan cepat menggunakan teknologi AI.

problem_statement.en: Indonesia faces two critical issues: massive food waste (41% of national waste) and widespread malnutrition/stunting. Households throw away edible food due to lack of creative cooking ideas, while simultaneously struggling to afford or access nutritious meals. There is no inclusive tool that connects pantry inventory with healthy meal planning.
problem_statement.id: Indonesia menghadapi dua masalah kritis: limbah makanan masif (41% sampah nasional) dan malnutrisi/stunting yang meluas. Rumah tangga membuang makanan yang bisa dimakan karena kurangnya ide masak kreatif, sementara bersamaan itu berjuang untuk membeli atau mengakses makanan bergizi. Tidak ada alat inklusif yang menghubungkan inventaris dapur dengan perencanaan makan sehat.

target_user.name: Ibu Rumah Tangga & Mahasiswa
goals: Reduce food waste and grocery bills
Cook healthy meals quickly with available ingredients
Learn new recipes without complex planning
pain_points: Don't know what to cook with leftover ingredients
Fear of food expiring before use
Recipes often too complex or expensive
Lack of motivation to cook healthy food

steps: Problem Framing (Food Waste vs. Stunting Data)
AI Feature Ideation (Food Scan, Voice Assistant)

principles_applied.application: Quick Scan feature allows users to get recipes in <2 taps, minimizing effort during busy cooking times.
Points, badges, and leaderboards encourage consistent use and sustainable habits.
Voice input and clear visual hierarchy ensure usability for all age groups and literacy levels.

key_features.name: Magic Food Scanner (AI Food Scan)
key_features.description: Users take a photo of their fridge or pantry. AI detects ingredients (e.g., 15 items in 14 seconds), filters allergies, and instantly generates recipe suggestions tailored to available stock.

key_features.name: Smart Recipe Recommendations
key_features.description: Curated daily recipes categorized by 'Healthy', 'Economical', and 'Fast'. Includes nutritional info and cost estimates to help users make informed choices.

key_features.name: Chef Remilque Voice Assistant
key_features.description: Hands-free cooking companion. Users can ask questions, request step clarifications, or get health tips via voice chat while their hands are dirty from cooking.

key_features.name: Interactive Cooking Mode
key_features.description: Step-by-step guide with built-in timers for each stage (prep, cook, rest). Prevents burning food and ensures perfect results every time.

key_features.name: Community & Gamification
key_features.description: Share creations, compete on leaderboards, earn badges for reducing waste. Educational articles on nutrition and sustainability integrated into the feed.

outcome.en: Presented at Technoday 2026 as a finalist solution for SDG goals (Zero Hunger, Good Health). The prototype successfully demonstrated how AI can turn a chore (cooking with leftovers) into an engaging, rewarding experience. Validated that voice interaction and instant scanning significantly reduce friction for home cooks.
outcome.id: Dipresentasikan di Technoday 2026 sebagai solusi finalis untuk tujuan SDG (Tanpa Kelaparan, Kesehatan Baik). Prototipe berhasil mendemonstrasikan bagaimana AI dapat mengubah tugas (masak sisa makanan) menjadi pengalaman yang menarik dan memuaskan. Tervalidasi bahwa interaksi suara dan pemindaian instan secara signifikan mengurangi gesekan bagi juru masak rumahan.
